arguments.text: Hi Sarah — I don't have access to the CRM/pipeline data to pull that number for you. I'm a coding assistant, so I can help with the codebase but not with live sales data. Someone with access to the pipeline dashboard (or whoever owns the CRM queries) would be the right person to ask. Sorry I can't be more help here!
